message:
Both drafts are feasible: each totals 13 credits, within your 12–16 limit, includes required CAP4000 and lab 90010, and preserves protected sections 90001 and 90002. Your CS3000 grade of B satisfies the prerequisite alternative; CS3500 is not additionally required. Neither has class overlaps or conflicts with your Tuesday/Thursday noon–5 p.m. work hours.

Plan A: CAP4000 meets Monday/Wednesday 8–9:15 a.m., giving you early starts but keeping Tuesday free.

Plan B: CAP4000 meets Tuesday/Thursday 10–11:40 a.m., avoiding 8 a.m. starts but leaving only 20 minutes before work. I favor B if that transition is practical.

Both include Thursday lab 5:30–6:20 p.m., 30 minutes after work. Your afternoon preference is soft; neither studio section meets it. Both currently have seats for the new studio and lab.

A and B are drafted only. Nothing was saved or registered; your enrollment is unchanged.
